note: Pinned revisions of the sibling repositories sb3-creator's cross-repo gates consume. CI checks these exact commits out beside the repo (.github/workflows/ci.yml) so the gates RUN rather than skip; test/helpers/siblings.mjs turns an absent sibling into a failure when CI=true. Update a pin deliberately, in its own commit, with the suite green against it. `rev` MUST be the FULL 40-character SHA: actions/checkout only recognises a full SHA as a commit, and turns anything shorter into `git fetch origin +refs/heads/<ref>*` — a branch glob that matches nothing. An abbreviated pin here took every CI run on main down at the checkout step, before lint, tests, the mutation prover or the build ran at all. gate-integrity asserts the length; `revShort` exists only for prose.

bw-board.why: the device/board simulator the gallery e2e and physics gates drive. Advanced from a301937 for the STM32F030 light tier: CortexM0Machine + the F0 board (RM0360 GPIO/TIM3/USART1/ADC + TIM3-compare PWM), the boundary-A stm32-adapter, the 'stm32f0' debug-target kind, and the stm32f030 bare-chip board KIND the new circuit.stm32f030.json benches place — without which the bench gates reject every F030 bench with unknown kind and the stm32f0-chain tests cannot even import src/cortex-m0-machine.js (the exact red on 9aef707's CI run). DELIBERATELY pinned BEFORE bw-cui2's attiny88 pa0->gnd2 rename (bw-board master has since moved past this sha): the rename chain's owner stated whoever bumps past it inherits the 135-circuit re-seat, and that re-seat is sequenced to happen once, after the cui sidecar step — this pin takes the F0 work and nothing of the rename. Suite 6610/0 against exactly this pair on 2026-08-25.

bw-circuit-ui.why: the canonical circuit model, engine, and the ONE wire-endpoint dialect reader the corpus gates read circuit.json through. Advanced from af5cc08 for the stm32f030 designer part (TSSOP20 sidecar + SVG, DIP-20 straddle footprint, passthrough kind, 3.3 V seated bench) — without which the 2133-circuit load gate cannot resolve the stm32f030 parts the new benches place. 06c7ea7 is EXACTLY the stm32f030-part commit and predates bw-cui2's attiny88 sidecar rename, for the same re-seat-once sequencing reason as the bw-board pin. Suite 6610/0 against exactly this pair on 2026-08-25.
